column3: All clauses agree on the separately collected metal, archiving and signed-sheet gate.
The actors for sign removal and road marking removal, original plan and organiser's copy all agree.
Both protect the complainant's address and allow the mural-only site address. Context details also match.
Lead-guide access is deactivated immediately and observer access retained until tour end in both.
Both use the opening reading of the new meter and retain the same account number.
The empty cartons are flattened before being placed in the collection cage, which is emptied before the morning delivery.
Both languages give the same steady-then-flashing definition and choose the first entry. The code is implied by order rather than numbering.
Both export all verified rows and suppress only notes in rows with personal data. Preview and file naming instructions match.
Both apply the torn-sample process to wrinkles within the test area, and agree on heat and batch counts.
Both choose the profile hiding notes and filenames and retain protections when changing screens.
Both use a dry cotton cloth and support the globe at the base.
Chinese explicitly says to test the spray first, while the English test is given after the coat instruction. The intended sequence is recoverable but English presentation could mislead.
Resident-only collection and return by the resident or nominated driver are identical.
The rain contingency, shuttle exception, common café and later route note match.
Both map straps to section B and require their return except when retained by request for fitting.
Both retain the later-swap blue-voucher option except after redemption of the replacement.
Both offer audio description and accessible seating guidance.
Both require each bow to be wrapped separately and the receiving school to acknowledge delivery by email.
Both provide the same waiver for renewing together and list everyone paid for on the receipt.
Both require removing notes before lending a photocopy and allow unused sheets to be kept.
Both withdraw the coursework while retaining anonymous comments unless identifying, including in the catalogue.
Both select the first transfer and leave the second untouched. Chinese clearly says reverse, whereas restore is ambiguous in English.
Both base student-mentor matches on areas of interest.
Both retain the writing folder for one term after final review.
